Activities & Workstreams

The Union works to transform the Arab world's significant energy and mineral resources into structured projects, strategic partnerships and concrete investment opportunities through integrated workstreams:

Arab integration & networking

Developing a cooperation network among governments, institutions and companies in the energy and minerals sectors to unify visions and coordinate action plans.

Investment promotion

Encouraging Arab and international investment and valorizing the region's opportunities into concrete projects.

Energy transition

Supporting renewable-energy, green-hydrogen, energy-efficiency and clean-energy projects and emissions reduction.

Mining sector development

Developing an Arab mining sector aligned with international best practices and sustainable resource management.

Research, innovation & technology transfer

Stimulating scientific research, integrating new technologies, and supporting innovation and entrepreneurship in both sectors.

Economic diplomacy & international partnerships

Building partnerships with Arab, regional and international institutions to strengthen the position of Arab countries in the energy and mining industries.

2026–2030 Roadmap

At the press conference following the General Assembly, the founding committee unveiled the Union's annual programme and its 2026–2030 roadmap, designed to launch initiatives, projects and partnerships serving the development of the energy and minerals sectors in Arab countries.

2026

Completing the institutional build-out: forming the Superior Council, Board of Directors, General Secretariat and specialized commissions, and launching membership.

2027

Activating the cooperation network, building partnerships with Arab, regional and international institutions, and launching first sectoral initiatives.

2028

Launching structured projects in energy transition and sustainable mining, and programmes for research, innovation and technology transfer.

2029

Advancing Arab and international investment and turning opportunities into strategic partnerships and concrete projects.

2030

Consolidating the Union's standing as the Arab reference platform and measuring its initiatives' impact on sustainable development and economic integration.

Arab Union for Energy & Minerals

A pan-Arab institutional platform advancing joint Arab action in the energy and minerals sectors. Founded July 2026, headquartered in Casablanca.

Informational content based on official press coverage of the founding announcement.
